barrett-m82.d: A legendary sniper that can one-shot anyone with a headshot

golden-ak-47.d: It is a gold-colored AK; there is not much else to say.

golden-barrett-m82.d: It is a gold-colored Barrett M82. Very expensive!

golden-deagle.d: It is a gold-colored Deagle; there is not much else to say.

c4.d: Explosive used for destroying vault doors

flashbang.d: A throwable grenade that creates a bright flash of light and a loud noise, temporarily blinding and deafening anyone nearby.

grenade-launcher.d: A grenade launcher that shoots grenades

m67.d: A throwable grenade that explodes after a few seconds

rpg-7.d: A rocket launcher that shoots rockets

ak-47.d: A very powerful rifle, but it lacks speed

awm.d: The AWM is a bolt-action sniper rifle renowned for its exceptional range and high damage output, making it a favorite among long-distance marksmen.

flamethrower.d: It is not that good, but it can be used to burn mutants.

fn-fal.d: The FN FAL is a heavy-hitting automatic rifle with excellent range and damage, making it a favorite for mid-to-long range engagements. It features moderate recoil and a solid magazine capacity, balancing power with control.

m4a1.d: The M4A1 is a lightweight and versatile carbine known for its high rate of fire and low recoil. It’s a perfect all-rounder for players who need a reliable weapon in close-quarters combat and mid-range engagements.

m60.d: Most used gun in the game, very OP

svd.d: The SVD is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that balances power and rate of fire, making it effective for both aggressive and defensive playstyles.

deagle.d: A powerful pistol with high damage and recoil

glock-18c.d: A fully automatic pistol with high fire rate

raygun.d: Powerful against mutants, but not so much against players.

sawn-off.d: You will not do much with this one.

skorpion.d: It is an average gun: not too good, not too bad.

kriss-vector.d: Very fast firing SMG with good damage

model-870.d: It is a shotgun, but a very bad and boring gun.

mp5k.d: A very fast SMG with good damage

p90.d: The P90 is a fan favorite SMG known for its iconic bullpup design and massive 50-round magazine, allowing for sustained fire and quick reloads.

spas-12.d: It is somehow more expensive than the Benelli and weaker than the Benelli.

ump-45.d: A police SMG; it is okay, I guess.

panther.d: The Panther is a flying vehicle that is obtained from Vehicle Crates. It is a fast and maneuverable vehicle that is perfect for transportation and combat

maverick.d: The Maverick is a fast and agile helicopter that is perfect for transportation and combat. It is a fan favorite among players for its speed and maneuverability

mini-bird.d: The Mini Bird is a fast and agile helicopter that is perfect for transportation and combat. It is mostly bought because it is the cheapest flying vehicle.

scout.d: It is a fast and agile helicopter that is perfect for transportation and combat

rooster.d: Cheapest of the motorcycles, gets the job done

shinobi.d: Most expensive motorcycle, not the rarest

aegis.d: A very sturdy and expensive vehicle.

beam.d: It is a very cool car, but not many players have bought it because there are better options at a similar price.

contender.d: The Contender is one of the most basic vehicles in the game. It is a sports car that many players use for its looks.

crowline.d: Not many players buy this one, but it looks very nice and old style

falcon-gt.d: The Falcon GT is a fast and agile sports car that is perfect for transportation and combat

g-cruiser.d: The G-Cruiser is a heavily armored SUV, used by teams

gemstone.d: Bought mainly for its cool design; it is not especially good at anything, and there are better options at a similar price.

mochi.d: Flippy floppy lights, but not bad for a beginner car

nomad.d: The Nomad is mostly bought by teams that do not have enough money for anything better.

pulse-477.d: The Pulse 477 is a fast and agile sports car that is perfect for transportation and combat

ranger.d: One of the cheapest cars in the game; it mostly looks good to new players, though.

razor.d: The Razor is a fast and agile sports car that is perfect for transportation and combat

spectre.d: The most expensive car in the game, bought for flex and speed

stallion-450.d: It is a very cool-looking car and one of the most beginner-friendly and affordable cars in the game.

vanguard.d: Let's be honest: you bought it for the mission or got it from the Robux pack.

zoro.d: The Zoro is a very strong car but it lacks speed

zorvello.d: The Zorvello is a very fast and agile sports car that is perfect for transportation and combat

empyrean.d: Fastest ground vehicle in the game, flex rights

horizon.d: Beginner-friendly, though it is difficult to obtain from crates, so I do not know whether it is worth it.

pulse-477-rs.d: Fast but not the fastest. It is a speedy car, but let's be honest: you wanted the Empyrean.

roku.d: Beginner-friendly, though it is difficult to obtain from crates, so I do not know whether it is worth it.

temporo.d: It looks like a car made out of LEGO, but it is very speedy.

rival.d: Decent acceleration and speed, pretty decent for beginners

reaper.d: It is a very good bike.

interceptor.d: Pretty fast car for a police vehicle

warden.d: The Warden is a heavily armored police car that is used by the police to patrol the city

cruiser.d: Your first car, brings back memories

blade.d: Blade is a fast and very armored car, which makes it good at both escaping and chasing

helix.d: A high-performance sports coupe built for speed, control, and sharp handling.

stinger.d: A sleek sport coupe tuned for quick cornering and confident highway pulls.

air-support.d: There's a lot of reasons to have a bird in the air. From rapid response to search and rescue and everything in between, a helicopter just makes everything easier.

all-points-bulletin.d:
These are the criminals on the Most Wanted list: they're the most dangerous of the bunch.

If you can manage to take them down, the reward is massive. Be careful though.

bang-and-clear.d: Every raid is a risk: that's why we have to use every tool at our disposal. We use these non-lethal munitions to keep ourselves safe. Every once in a while a stun grenade ends up in a crib and people complain. That's life though. The baby probably had it coming to them.

bang-and-clear-2.d: Every raid is a risk: that's why we have to use every tool at our disposal. We use these non-lethal munitions to keep ourselves safe. Every once in a while a stun grenade ends up in a crib and people complain. That's life though. The baby probably had it coming to them.

bulletproof.d: The real weight of your armor doesn't come from the gear and ceramic plates, it's about what it does to your mind. It's a constant, physical reminder that you might be killed today. It warps your reality - and, pretty soon, everyone looks like an enemy, like a target. And that's how you look like to everyone else.

calling-all-units.d: We're seeing new reports of increased Syndicate activity. They're running together in bigger numbers now. You're going to need a big squad in order to deal with them safely.

community-outreach.d: A big part of the job is putting on a friendly face for the community. Being there for your neighbors. Go out there, knock on some doors, and shake some hands. Get to know the people you're fighting for.

con-air.d:
We need you down at the airport ASAP: there's been a hijacking. A crew snuck into the cargo plane as it was refueling and took the controls.

Make your way on before takeoff and thwart the robbery before they get away with the plane and everything in it.

cop-killer.d: Cops aren't exactly popular. You never know who has it out for you. If you're not looking over your shoulder, one day someone will walk right up and shoot you in the back.

counter-intel.d: Ofy is an agent of a much larger criminal organization known as the Syndicate. We need to learn more, so it is time for you to go undercover. Infiltrate the Syndicate hideout and make a copy of any useful information you find.

dirty-money-1.d: The intel you gathered suggests that Buck Moneymaker has ties to the Syndicate. He owns two banks: one downtown and one smaller bank in the Badlands. Raid them both.

dirty-money-2.d: A lot of money moves through this city - and not all of it is legitimate. Seize the inventory manifests for the Jewelry Store and the City Port. Let's see what they're hiding.

dirty-money-3.d: Buck is using the bank to launder his dirty money. Every so often he gets a big shipment of rare jewels and stores them in the main vault downtown. Raid the vault and bring back any evidence you find.

first-responder.d: Sometimes you're gonna be first on the scene. You won't have time to wait - you'll just have to act. People will need you to step up. Their lives will be in your hands.

first-responder-2.d: Sometimes you're gonna be first on the scene. You won't have time to wait - you'll just have to act. People will need you to step up. Their lives will be in your hands.

first-responder-3.d: Sometimes you're gonna be first on the scene. You won't have time to wait - you'll just have to act. People will need you to step up. Their lives will be in your hands.

hot-pursuit.d: If you want to be effective in a high speed chase, you're going to have to master the pit maneuver. Position yourself behind their vehicle and slam their rear: they'll go spinning.

introduction-bert.d: Bert is the Captain of the Oasis City Police. Word is he's been looking for you specifically. Go meet him up at the Police Station and see what he wants. If it was that bad, you'd be in cuffs already.

loss-prevention.d: We got a tip that a crew is going to hit the Pear Store. Go stake it out and roll in when they least expect it.

loss-prevention-2.d: We got a tip that a crew is going to hit the Pear Store. Go stake it out and roll in when they least expect it.

night-shift.d: Night-time is when all the real dangerous types come out. You're going to have to keep your wits about you. Go take a look around downtown at night and you'll see what I mean.

officer-down.d: Fight or flight. That's when your stomach overrides your brain - and forces you to act. No matter how bad it looks, no matter how afraid you get: never leave your brothers and sisters behind. That's our code.

on-patrol.d: You're only as effective as the man sitting next to you. Surround yourself with the best and you will become the best. Build a crew of people that have your back, soldiers you trust. Then you'll be invincible.

on-patrol-2.d: You're only as effective as the man sitting next to you. Surround yourself with the best and you will become the best. Build a crew of people that have your back, soldiers you trust. Then you'll be invincible.

on-patrol-3.d: You're only as effective as the man sitting next to you. Surround yourself with the best and you will become the best. Build a crew of people that have your back, soldiers you trust. Then you'll be invincible.

police-sharpshooter.d: It's time to prove your marksmanship. Take out targets from over 100m away using a high-powered rifle. You know what Whitman and Oswald had in common? They were both marine snipers, trained right here in the U.S. of A. With a little training, you'll be able to do the same thing.

public-relations-1.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-2.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-3.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-4.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

rough-cargo.d: Word around town is the Syndicate is going after military airdrops. We can't let them get access to that kind of hardware. Go to the airport and seize the flight log so we can make it there first.

search-and-seizure.d: These scumbags are just running around with bags of stolen gear - as if we don't have eyes. Go out there and shake them down. If they ask you for a warrant, just give me a call.

service-fee.d: Gas station ATMs are a prime target for criminals. It's easy money - until you get caught. Patrol gas stations and look for any suspicious activity.

smash-and-grab.d: Suit up: we received another call. Jewelry heist in progress. Armed suspects. Bring them back in cuffs, and don't forget the jewelry either.

stolen-goods.d: We received a tip about a shady pawn shop peddling stolen goods. I've had my eyes on this spineless crook for a while. Go down there and sweat him.

tactical-unit.d:
It's time to familiarize yourself with special weapons and tactics, S.W.A.T.

Hostage rescue. High-risk warrants and standoffs. Counter-terrorism. These all require specialized tools, and a unique approach.

the-italian-job.d: We got a call of a heist happening downtown at the central bank. Gold is their target - don't let them get away.

jingle-balls.d: Mrs. Claus doesn't think our tree is fancy enough... In the spirit of Christmas, can you find me some ornaments?

jingle-balls-2.d: Mrs. Claus doesn't think our tree is fancy enough... In the spirit of Christmas, can you find me some extra expensive ornaments?

santas-helper.d: I was flying over the mountains into the city and a gust of wind knocked my sleigh and presents out of the sky! Please, help me find them! Christmas depends on it!

1-toy-drive.d: It turns out there were some priceless toys in this year's presents that I can't afford to lose. Bring them back to me and I'll make it worth your while!

2-toy-drive.d: Kids are getting more and more spoiled every year! These toys will be harder to find, but I'll put in a good word for you with the Easter Bunny if you succeed!

forbidden-meat.d: Business has been rough lately: meat prices have skyrocketed. If you can help find an alternative supply, we'll be able to stay open. Find a good meat source, and use the grinder in the back room to see if it makes for good burger meat.

syndicegg.d: Word around town is you've been looking for eggs. I can hook you up, but you're going to need to do some stuff for me first.

the-egg-hunt.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

the-egg-hunt-2.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

the-egg-hunt-3.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

artisan.d: I've been brainstorming some ideas for gun modifications, but I'm too busy to test them myself. I want you to follow these instructions exactly, test them out, and then get back to me: Mod UMP 45 with Holographic Sight and a Tactical Laser.

artisan-2.d: Back for more? Let's get to it. Same as last time: set up the gun, test it out, and head back here. Mod the Model 870 with 12 Gauge Slugs and Vertical Foregrip.

artisan-3.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Mod Uzi with Mono Suppressor and Uzi Stock.

artisan-4.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded AK-47 with Mono Suppressor, Tactical Laser, and Horizontal Foregrip.

artisan-5.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded Glock 18c with Pistol Suppressor, Reflex Sight and Glock Stock.

artisan-6.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded M4A1 with ACOG, Horizontal Foregrip, and Tactical Laser.

artisan-7.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded AWM with Reflex Sight, Mono Suppressor and Tactical Laser.

artisan-8.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded M60 with Rifle Scope and M60 Bipod.

bank-heist.d: We've been watching you. Don't know who we are? Good, let's keep it that way for now. If you want to be a real criminal, you're going to have to prove you're worthy by doing a big job. Hit the central bank downtown and that will get you our respect.

get-rolling.d: Navigating the terrain of the Oasis is challenging, so let's get you a new set of wheels. Go to the Bayview Dealership and ask for Cody. He'll be expecting you.

contraband.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-2.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-3.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-4.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

crime-squad.d: The Syndicate is growing - it's time you become a squad leader. Recruit others to the cause. We're going to need all the help we can get.

crime-squad-2.d: You're part of a brotherhood now. From now on until the day you die, wherever you are, every member of the Syndicate is your brother. People die. The Syndicate lives forever.

crime-squad-3.d: Your squad has been selected for a special operation. Hit the big ones: the bank and the jewelry store.

crime-squad-4.d: Your squad is being deployed on a jewelry store operation. Crack the vault and kill any cops standing in your way.

crime-squad-5.d: Today you're being sent directly into enemy territory. Deploy your squad to Fort Emberreach and hack the secure crates. Kill everyone you see.

data-disk.d: One of my agents was en route with critical information when their plane suddenly crash-landed... no survivors. The plane went down somewhere around Frostspire Summit. Find out what happened and retrieve the data.

diamonds-and-pearls.d: Another order for Ofy. Sell a bag to Ofy containing 6 Pearl Necklaces and 2 Diamonds - all at once.

fence.d: You're gonna need connections to survive and make a name for yourself as a criminal. Money talks. Work with my associate Ofy and sell $10,000 worth of stolen goods through the pawn shop.

fence-2.d: That was a good start, but now let's up the ante. This time, sell $30,000 worth of stolen goods through the pawn shop. Pull off bigger jobs, get paid more. That's the name of the game.

front-toward-enemy.d: We're going to need some more firepower. Establish a broker contract for the purchase of RPG-7 rocket launchers.

fuel-depot.d: We've been in the shadows for far too long. I think it's time we come out of hiding. I want to put a real scare into those cops, so let's make some fireworks. Fuel Tankers are the target. You'll need explosives to really make them go boom. Find 3 different tankers and light them up.

gem-collector.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-2.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-3.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-4.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-5.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

going-loud.d: The Syndicate is at war. We need to strike the police before they strike us. Take out 8 officers and don't get caught. Show them we're serious.

hidden-cargo.d: We received word that the government has a special order on the manifest at the cargo port sometime today. Go to the port and find what they're hiding.

incriminating-data.d: From what I could decrypt on the disk, members of the city's government are implicated in some shady dealings - things they don't want to come to light. They'll do anything to keep the word from getting out, including going to war with The Syndicate. We need more evidence so we can stop them.

lights-out.d: We don't want the cops sniffing around our business, so let's hit them where it hurts. Disable three of their cruisers; that'll keep them from interfering with our operations. Don't get caught.

lockpicker.d: A real professional is one who can open a safe without destroying it. You did well with the last job, this time I want you to go after luxury homes. Rich people only. Search their houses, porches, garages and crack any safes you find.

lockpicker-2.d: Every safe can be cracked, it just depends how skilled you are. Those luxury homes were more lucrative than I'd realized. Rob 30 more house safes and see what you find.

lockpicker-3.d: No lock is pick-proof, but high-security cylinders raise time, skill, and tool requirements significantly. Practice makes perfect - crack 50 house safes. Then you'll be a master locksmith.

most-wanted.d: Word of your exploits has gotten around - Captain Bert has put an APB out on you. Don't let them catch you. Escape and lay low for awhile.

nightstalker.d: It's time to clean house. Operating under the cover of darkness gives us the element of surprise. Kill anyone you deem dangerous to The Syndicate.

oasis-eleven.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. We have intel that a shipment of gold is coming through soon. Break in, get the gold, and get out.

oasis-eleven-2.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. This time, there's going to be a shipment of gems: sapphires. Steal as many as you can.

oasis-eleven-3.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Ruby Vaults are particularly valuable. Comes with a larger amount of cash too.

oasis-eleven-4.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Emeralds are among the rarest and most expensive gems. Bring back as many as you can.

oasis-eleven-5.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Amethysts are as rare as it gets. Pulling off just one Amethyst heist will make you rich.

payday.d: You're becoming a real pro... Let's try a bigger heist. Steal $50,000 from the bank vault. Don't forget about the gold.

phantom.d: If you want to be a top criminal, you're going to need speed. The Spectre is best in class: engine, aerodynamics, the works.

ring-collector.d: Expensive rings fetch a high price on the black market. A client of mine wants some samples - could be a lucrative deal for both of us.

smuggler.d: You're trusted now. From now on, bring all stolen goods to me. I'll pay a hefty premium, double what Ofy was paying. For your trouble.

smuggler-2.d: I have buyers waiting, so let's do some more business together. Up the volume to $100,000 this time. The more we flip, the more you're paid.

smuggler-3.d: You've proven yourself capable, now let's really get serious. $300,000 of volume this time. My buyers are waiting - don't disappoint me.

smuggler-4.d: You didn't seem to have any trouble with that, let's make it $500,000 this time. Remember, time is money. My money.

smuggler-5.d: We're in the big leagues now: seven figures. One million. You know what they say: the first million is always the hardest.

smuggler-6.d: You're probably wondering by now why I keep badgering you to make money. That's because the Syndicate is an expensive operation - it takes a lot of money to keep our little rebellion afloat. You're a key player now. Don't disappoint us.

smuggler-7.d: Financing an operation like this is no easy task. We need all the money we can get. This one is a hefty price tag, but you'll be paid handsomely if you succeed.

stealth-pilot.d: The Syndicate needs a vehicle that can conduct airborne raids. Go speak to Davis, our contact at the heliport. He'll walk you through the licensing and red tape.

submariner.d: This time the bulk order is going to Ofy. Ofy has a client who is in need of some new fancy watches. Sell Ofy a bag containing 3 Rollies, all at once.

syndicate-dogs.d: It's time for you to learn how to pull a proper jewel heist. You're gonna need the proper tools first. Go purchase the Buzzsaw from Ofy's pawn shop. It's the only thing strong enough to get through the display cases.

syndicate-dogs-2.d: The jewelry vault is reinforced - high explosives won't cut it. You'll need a specialized drill. Go see Rod at the Port. He'll have what you need to break in.

teller.d: I'll let you in on a little secret: the entire system is designed to keep you down and poor. Banks are charging you money to get your own money out of the machine. Whoever thought you'd pay cash to get cash? That's where we've gotten to. They own you.

teller-2.d: If people actually had any understanding of our banking and monetary system, there would be a revolution by tomorrow morning. You work hard, and your money gets deposited into a bank. They're stealing from you, too.

the-deposit.d: Petty theft isn't glamorous, but every master thief starts small. I'd rather be a thief than a slave with a white collar, wouldn't you? Hit 4 gas stations around Oasis. They keep their money in a safe in the back. Just dust for prints and crack the combo lock.

the-estate.d: I need you to establish a new Syndicate safehouse. Somewhere nicer than this: somewhere low heat, where we can broker more deals.

the-files.d: The government, the military - they've all been paid off. There's a black corporation conducting dangerous experiments: apparently they're who is responsible for the mysterious Anomaly. Infiltrate the Military Base and recover any documents you find on this. We need to figure out what's going on.

the-heaviest-bag.d: Money doesn't buy happiness - it buys freedom. Fill your loot bag to the brim - $500,000 worth.

timepiece.d: Ripping off rich people is the easiest way to make money in the crime game. There's this rich banking corporate type - Buck Moneymaker. He goes around flashing that watch of his, a priceless timepiece. I want you to steal it from him. Check his office in the bank and bring it to me.

upgrade.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 PearBooks, 2 PearPads, and 2 Flash Drives.

upgrade-2.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 GoldPads, 1 HDD, 1 PSU, and 1 GPU.

upgrade-3.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 GoldBooks, 2 GoldPhones, 1 GoldPods, and 1 Bitcoin

wargames.d: The Syndicate is gearing up for a raid on Fort Emberreach. We're going to need everyone we can get for this operation. Break into the base, plunder their weapons, and kill everyone you see.

wargames-2.d: Fort Emberreach is at the heart of the entire government operation. Raze the base. This raid will be a bullet straight through their hearts.

weapons-cache.d: The Syndicate has hidden various weapons caches around the Oasis, but we've lost track of some of them. If you can locate them, I'll be in your debt.

weapons-cache-2.d: The Syndicate has hidden various weapons caches around the Oasis, but we've lost track of some of them. If you can locate them, I'll be in your debt.

first-responder-part-2.d: Sometimes you're gonna be first on the scene. You won't have time to wait - you'll just have to act. People will need you to step up. Their lives will be in your hands.

first-responder-part-3.d: Sometimes you're gonna be first on the scene. You won't have time to wait - you'll just have to act. People will need you to step up. Their lives will be in your hands.

loss-prevention-part-1.d: We got a tip that a crew is going to hit the Pear Store. Go stake it out and roll in when they least expect it.

loss-prevention-part-2.d: We got a tip that a crew is going to hit the Pear Store. Go stake it out and roll in when they least expect it.

officer-down-part-1.d: Fight or flight. That's when your stomach overrides your brain - and forces you to act. No matter how bad it looks, no matter how afraid you get: never leave your brothers and sisters behind. That's our code.

on-patrol-part-1.d: You're only as effective as the man sitting next to you. Surround yourself with the best and you will become the best. Build a crew of people that have your back, soldiers you trust. Then you'll be invincible.

on-patrol-part-2.d: You're only as effective as the man sitting next to you. Surround yourself with the best and you will become the best. Build a crew of people that have your back, soldiers you trust. Then you'll be invincible.

police-sharpshooter-part-1.d: It's time to prove your marksmanship. Take out targets from over 100m away using a high-powered rifle. You know what Whitman and Oswald had in common? They were both marine snipers, trained right here in the U.S. of A. With a little training, you'll be able to do the same thing.

public-relations-part-1.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-part-2.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-part-3.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

public-relations-part-4.d: It's time to trade in that boring cruiser of yours for something more exciting. Our image, as a department, is important. What else are we going to do with all that tax money?

search-seizure-part-1.d: These scumbags are just running around with bags of stolen gear - as if we don't have eyes. Go out there and shake them down. If they ask you for a warrant, just give me a call.

smash-grab-part-1.d: Suit up: we received another call. Jewelry heist in progress. Armed suspects. Bring them back in cuffs, and don't forget the jewelry either.

jingle-balls-part-1.d: Mrs. Claus doesn't think our tree is fancy enough... In the spirit of Christmas, can you find me some ornaments?

jingle-balls-part-2.d: Mrs. Claus doesn't think our tree is fancy enough... In the spirit of Christmas, can you find me some extra expensive ornaments?

toy-drive-part-1.d: It turns out there were some priceless toys in this year's presents that I can't afford to lose. Bring them back to me and I'll make it worth your while!

toy-drive-part-2.d: Kids are getting more and more spoiled every year! These toys will be harder to find, but I'll put in a good word for you with the Easter Bunny if you succeed!

the-egg-hunt-part-1.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

the-egg-hunt-part-2.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

the-egg-hunt-part-3.d: i'm looking for my eggs, have you seen them??? i've been looking all over!! if you can find them, i have lots of cool rewards!!! :O

artisan-part-1.d: I've been brainstorming some ideas for gun modifications, but I'm too busy to test them myself. I want you to follow these instructions exactly, test them out, and then get back to me: Mod UMP 45 with Holographic Sight and a Tactical Laser.

artisan-part-2.d: Back for more? Let's get to it. Same as last time: set up the gun, test it out, and head back here. Mod the Model 870 with 12 Gauge Slugs and Vertical Foregrip.

artisan-part-3.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Mod Uzi with Mono Suppressor and Uzi Stock.

artisan-part-4.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded AK-47 with Mono Suppressor, Tactical Laser, and Horizontal Foregrip.

artisan-part-5.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded Glock 18c with Pistol Suppressor, Reflex Sight and Glock Stock.

artisan-part-6.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded M4A1 with ACOG, Horizontal Foregrip, and Tactical Laser.

artisan-part-7.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded AWM with Reflex Sight, Mono Suppressor and Tactical Laser.

artisan-part-8.d: Let's get right into it. Set up the gun, test it out, and come back: Bring me a modded M60 with Rifle Scope and M60 Bipod.

contraband-part-1.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-part-2.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-part-3.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

contraband-part-4.d: We have some clients looking to procure powerful firearms. Ghost guns only, no serial numbers, nothing store bought. When you find them, sell them to Rod at the port. He'll facilitate the transaction.

crime-squad-part-1.d: The Syndicate is growing - it's time you become a squad leader. Recruit others to the cause. We're going to need all the help we can get.

crime-squad-part-2.d: You're part of a brotherhood now. From now on until the day you die, wherever you are, every member of the Syndicate is your brother. People die. The Syndicate lives forever.

crime-squad-part-3.d: Your squad has been selected for a special operation. Hit the big ones: the bank and the jewelry store.

crime-squad-part-4.d: Your squad is being deployed on a jewelry store operation. Crack the vault and kill any cops standing in your way.

crime-squad-part-5.d: Today you're being sent directly into enemy territory. Deploy your squad to Fort Emberreach and hack the secure crates. Kill everyone you see.

fence-part-1.d: You're gonna need connections to survive and make a name for yourself as a criminal. Money talks. Work with my associate Ofy and sell $10,000 worth of stolen goods through the pawn shop.

fence-part-2.d: That was a good start, but now let's up the ante. This time, sell $30,000 worth of stolen goods through the pawn shop. Pull off bigger jobs, get paid more. That's the name of the game.

gem-collector-part-1.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-part-2.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-part-3.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-part-4.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

gem-collector-part-5.d: There's high demand for rare gems on the black market. If you can bring me some, I'll make it worth your while.

lockpicker-part-1.d: A real professional is one who can open a safe without destroying it. You did well with the last job, this time I want you to go after luxury homes. Rich people only. Search their houses, porches, garages and crack any safes you find.

lockpicker-part-2.d: Every safe can be cracked, it just depends how skilled you are. Those luxury homes were more lucrative than I'd realized. Rob 30 more house safes and see what you find.

lockpicker-part-3.d: No lock is pick-proof, but high-security cylinders raise time, skill, and tool requirements significantly. Practice makes perfect - crack 50 house safes. Then you'll be a master locksmith.

oasis-eleven-part-1.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. We have intel that a shipment of gold is coming through soon. Break in, get the gold, and get out.

oasis-eleven-part-2.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. This time, there's going to be a shipment of gems: sapphires. Steal as many as you can.

oasis-eleven-part-3.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Ruby Vaults are particularly valuable. Comes with a larger amount of cash too.

oasis-eleven-part-4.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Emeralds are among the rarest and most expensive gems. Bring back as many as you can.

oasis-eleven-part-5.d: Every so often, a huge shipment of valuables comes through the bank. Amethysts are as rare as it gets. Pulling off just one Amethyst heist will make you rich.

ring-collector-part-1.d: Expensive rings fetch a high price on the black market. A client of mine wants some samples - could be a lucrative deal for both of us.

smuggler-part-1.d: You're trusted now. From now on, bring all stolen goods to me. I'll pay a hefty premium, double what Ofy was paying. For your trouble.

smuggler-part-2.d: I have buyers waiting, so let's do some more business together. Up the volume to $100,000 this time. The more we flip, the more you're paid.

smuggler-part-3.d: You've proven yourself capable, now let's really get serious. $300,000 of volume this time. My buyers are waiting - don't disappoint me.

smuggler-part-4.d: You didn't seem to have any trouble with that, let's make it $500,000 this time. Remember, time is money. My money.

smuggler-part-5.d: We're in the big leagues now: seven figures. One million. You know what they say: the first million is always the hardest.

smuggler-part-6.d: You're probably wondering by now why I keep badgering you to make money. That's because the Syndicate is an expensive operation - it takes a lot of money to keep our little rebellion afloat. You're a key player now. Don't disappoint us.

smuggler-part-7.d: Financing an operation like this is no easy task. We need all the money we can get. This one is a hefty price tag, but you'll be paid handsomely if you succeed.

syndicate-dogs-part-1.d: It's time for you to learn how to pull a proper jewel heist. You're gonna need the proper tools first. Go purchase the Buzzsaw from Ofy's pawn shop. It's the only thing strong enough to get through the display cases.

syndicate-dogs-part-2.d: The jewelry vault is reinforced - high explosives won't cut it. You'll need a specialized drill. Go see Rod at the Port. He'll have what you need to break in.

teller-part-1.d: I'll let you in on a little secret: the entire system is designed to keep you down and poor. Banks are charging you money to get your own money out of the machine. Whoever thought you'd pay cash to get cash? That's where we've gotten to. They own you.

teller-part-2.d: If people actually had any understanding of our banking and monetary system, there would be a revolution by tomorrow morning. You work hard, and your money gets deposited into a bank. They're stealing from you, too.

upgrade-part-1.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 PearBooks, 2 PearPads, and 2 Flash Drives.

upgrade-part-2.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 GoldPads, 1 HDD, 1 PSU, and 1 GPU.

upgrade-part-3.d: I have a client that wants to buy tech, but only in bulk. All or nothing. Sell me a bag containing 2 GoldBooks, 2 GoldPhones, 1 GoldPods, and 1 Bitcoin

wargames-part-1.d: The Syndicate is gearing up for a raid on Fort Emberreach. We're going to need everyone we can get for this operation. Break into the base, plunder their weapons, and kill everyone you see.

wargames-part-2.d: Fort Emberreach is at the heart of the entire government operation. Raze the base. This raid will be a bullet straight through their hearts.

weapons-cache-part-1.d: The Syndicate has hidden various weapons caches around the Oasis, but we've lost track of some of them. If you can locate them, I'll be in your debt.

weapons-cache-part-2.d: The Syndicate has hidden various weapons caches around the Oasis, but we've lost track of some of them. If you can locate them, I'll be in your debt.

20-bag-boost-12-hours.d: Increases your bag capacity by 20 for 12 hours. [Time goes down even when not in-game]

5-bag-boost-12-hours.d: Increases your bag capacity by 5 for 12 hours. [Time goes down even when not in-game]

10-bag-boost-12-hours.d: Increases your bag capacity by 10 for 12 hours. [Time goes down even when not in-game]

get-2-500-000-cash.d: Instantly adds 2,500,000 cash to your account.

get-1-000-000-cash.d: Instantly adds 1,000,000 cash to your account.

get-400-000-cash.d: Instantly adds 400,000 cash to your account.

get-200-000-cash.d: Instantly adds 200,000 cash to your account.

get-50-000-cash.d: Instantly adds 50,000 cash to your account.

daily-printer.d: Gives x1 Money Printera at 50% the price.

x11-money-printers.d: Gives x11 Money Printers and an extra 2 for first purchase.

weapon-pack.d: A bundle of weapons containing the RPG, Benelli M1014, UMP 45 and Uzi.

mini-vec-pack.d: Includes the Mini Bird helicopter and Kriss Vector

vanguard-pack.d: Includes the Vanguard car, SPAS-12 and x3 Money Printers

bert.d: Officer recruiting undercover agents from criminal ranks via the Loyalty Test mission.

cody.d: The owner of Bayview Motors, offering car sales and custom modifications.

dan.d: Diner owner facing meat shortages. Seeks alternative supplies through the Forbidden Meat mission.

davy.d: The owner of Davis Heliport, offering helicopters and other flying vehicles for sale.

erik.d: Arms dealer specializing in guns, ammo, and modifications. Offers Artisan missions for testing gun mods.

justin.d: Owner of Lock n’ Load Armory, specializing in the sale and modification of weapons.

ofy.d: Ofy is the main person to sell your hard-earned (stolen) loot to. He gives you cash instantly, but at a lower price than Sir B.

rod.d: The current manager of Oasis City Port, specializing in overseas trading. You can sell guns to him for 35% of their rebuy price, get information about loot crates, and buy vault crackers from him.

sir-b.d: Syndicate leader directing operations against law enforcement and specializing in black market dealing.

softy.d: Crystal Club & Resort employee currently assigned to the Daily Wheel Spin, available after 15 minutes of playtime.

christmas-2025.d: The first annual Christmas event in Wanted! Santa crashed his sleigh and needed help recovering presents and ornaments scattered across the map.

easter-2026.d: The first annual Easter event in Wanted! The Easter Bunny has dropped eggs all across the map, and it's up to you to collect them!

halloween-2026.d: The first annual Halloween event in Wanted! Mutants have taken over the map and need to be defeated.

july-4th-2026.d: The first annual 4th of July event in Wanted!

4th-of-july-2026.d: The first annual 4th of July event in Wanted!

mystery-gift.d: A mysterious gift with very good content

money-printer.d: Most used economy item, prints money for you

buzzsaw.d: Used to break the reinforced glass, decent melee weapon

skeleton-key.d: Used to open the door to fight the Crypt Keeper during the Halloween event.

speakers-amulet.d: Used to speak to ghosts during the Halloween event.

vault-cracker.d: Used to open the Jewelry Store vaults, very useful

ak-47-crate.d: One of the most common crates in the game. It gives you a free AK-47 with a Mono Suppressor and Horizontal Foregrip pre-attached.

aug-a1-crate.d: One of the most common crates in the game. It is a crate that gives you a free AUG A1

awm-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free AWM, useful for missions that require a sniper rifle.

benelli-m1014-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free Benelli M1014 with a Tactical Laser and Vertical Foregrip pre-attached

glock-18c-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free Glock 18C with a Reflex Sight, Pistol Suppressor, and Pistol Stock pre-attached.

m4a1-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free M4A1 with an ACOG Sight, Horizontal Foregrip, and Tactical Laser pre-attached.

rpg-7-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free RPG-7

ump-45-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free UMP 45 with a Holographic Sight and Tactical Laser pre-attached

uzi-crate.d: It is a crate that gives you a free Uzi with an Uzi Stock pre-attached
